body.name: c_{1-\alpha}^\star
body.construction: Let \(\widehat\sigma_j^2\) be the \(j\)-th counterfactual diagonal entry of \(\widehat\Omega_\eta\). Define \(c_{1-\alpha}^\star\) as the conditional \((1-\alpha)\)-quantile of \[\max_{1\le j\le J}\left|K^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^K\xi_i\widehat\Phi_{\theta,i,j}/\widehat\sigma_j\right|,\] and define the band by \(\widehat\theta_j\pm c_{1-\alpha}^\star\widehat\sigma_j/\sqrt K\).
